newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 31.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JAN 31.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A handgrenade explosion in a Chinese restaurant, the deadliest in a spate of bombings in Budapest, killed the wife and the daughter of the owner Thursday night.
- More and more hospitals limit the visits to the patients due to the flu epidemic.

- The Parliament begins its spring legislative session on Monday. The agenda includes the social security reform, the election of new constitutional judges and the discussion of the draft health care and judicial laws.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn negatiated with U.S. Congressman Tom Lantos, but the topics of the talks have not been published.
- The Budapest Archives denied that they had published recently secret documents about the Holocaust.
